_comment: Data contract for the Cumbre Report screen. POST /analyze (multipart: audio file + JSON below) returns this object. Every value the Report renders should come from here — the prototype hardcodes these. Numbers shown are the prototype's example song 'Higher Ground'.

scores.verdict: Strong bones, real altitude. Three clean moves put you on the summit.

keep.title: The hook is sticky.
keep.note: The chorus melody is instantly singable — your strongest hold on the wall.

keep.title: Production sits pro.
keep.note: Clean low end and a present vocal — this already reads radio-grade.

keep.title: Real emotional pull.
keep.note: Verse 1 lands honest and unforced — don't over-polish it.

fixes.title: Lift the second chorus
fixes.note: The summit chorus lands at the same height as the first. Stack a harmony or octave vocal so the peak actually feels higher.

fixes.title: Anchor verse 2's imagery
fixes.note: Lines 3–4 drift abstract. Tie them to one concrete image and the story pulls climbers all the way in.

fixes.title: Carve space in the low-mids
fixes.note: 200–400 Hz is crowded. Trim the rhythm guitar a couple dB so the vocal can breathe on the climb.

mix.note: Your master is ~7 dB louder than Spotify's −14 LUFS target, so it'll be turned down on playback. Pull the limiter back for more punch and breathing room.
